notes.title: Trails series updates
notes.content:
Our wonderful developer, Sara, is updating the Trails games with some new features!
Turbo mode!
DirectX 9!
Other fanciness!
Full blog with details here!

If you have feedback or encounter any issues with these updates, feel free to email support@xseedgames.com with full details and your CPU and GPU.
